claims.claim_text: The indexed Roderick W. Cameron is identified with high confidence as Roderick William "Rory" Cameron, whom a New York Times profile places in an OSS assignment during World War II.
claims.evidence_excerpt: In World War II, Cameron was assigned to the Office of Strategic Services
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A New York Times profile names Roderick Cameron, gives his William middle name and Rory nickname, and explicitly states that he was assigned to the OSS during World War II.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the uncommon exact first name, matching W middle initial expanded as William, exact surname, explicit OSS service, and corroborative New York Times obituary naming Roderick W. Cameron as the history and travel writer. The indexed Box 103 file has not been reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The profile places Cameron in an OSS assignment during World War II but does not establish his occupation, employer, or institutional status immediately before that assignment.
claims.match_notes: The neighboring Roderick Cameron index row is retained as a separate unresolved entity and both rows are flagged as a possible duplicate group. No travel-writing, editorial, inherited-wealth, residence, education, or later design activity is converted into a pre-OSS affiliation.
